stem.text: Compound **S** can be extracted from natural compounds. Reacting **S** with hot, concentrated $\text{KMnO}_4$ produces the organic product, **T**. Some of the absorptions found in the infra-red spectra of **S** and **T** are described.
**S** has no strong absorption between $1670$ and $1740\,\text{cm}^{-1}$.
**T** has a strong absorption at $1720\,\text{cm}^{-1}$ but has **no** strong, broad absorption between $2500$ and $3000\,\text{cm}^{-1}$.
From this information, what could be the formulae of **S** and **T**?

B.alt: Skeletal formula: six-membered ring with two C=C bonds, carrying a methyl group and an isopropyl group

C.alt: Skeletal formula: CH3CO group attached to a cyclohexene ring with a ring C=C bond and two methyl groups

D.alt: Skeletal formula: six-membered ring with a ring C=C bearing a methyl group and an exocyclic C=C bearing two methyl groups
